properties.label: 3921 Woodview Ct
properties.detail: Eric's house. Section 30, lot 5 on the 1850s survey, about 300 m west of Lambert Lake's west shore (Ramsey County parcel centroid).

properties.label: St. John the Evangelist
properties.detail: Abraham gave the land for the cemetery (1851) and logs for the first church. He is buried in the family lot here (d. 1875).

properties.label: Lambert Lake
properties.detail: The center of the island, which is the center of the ring. The lake was drained in the 1940s; it is a wetland on Lambert Creek today.
